calibration.general_scale: Colony-count total mutant estimate refined during fitting.
calibration.canUVanine_scale: Fit non-UV population to canonical Luria-Delbrück to fix read-to-mutant scale, then use in UV comparisons.
calibration.reported_corroboration: Authors report inferred induced rates agree with independent pre/post-UV mutant colony counts; SI details not acquired or independently verified.
calibration.known_abundance_spike_in: Future implementation suggestion, not implemented-standard evidence.
calibration.TMD_rule: A fit on a separate calibration experiment can be assessable given identifiability, honest joint uncertainty, justified count law, native context transport and a freeze before evaluation; fitting the held-out evaluation endpoint cannot simultaneously provide its independently frozen supply predictor.

mechanism_identifiability.source_status: General distinguishability remains open; mutant fitness and phenotypic switching can both affect distribution tails.
mechanism_identifiability.inference_limit: Comparisons among specified model families do not uniquely establish all molecular mechanisms.

unit_and_dependence.reported: Pooled barcode lineages with approximately ten founder cells per barcode and computational virtual-lineage merging.

loss_and_inheritance.observations: Postselection non-detection and stability among detected barcode frequencies in the yeast selection context.
unresolved: phenotypic delay and sequencing detection limits
loss_and_inheritance.boundary: These observations do not establish no mutation birth or native WS transport.
